title: Todoist Recurring Task Completion Drop
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=todoist:task
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(completed="true")) as completed_tasks, count as total_tasks by label _time
| eval completion_pct=round(100*completed_tasks/total_tasks,1)
| where total_tasks>=5 AND completion_pct<70
| sort completion_pct
description: Uses Todoist recurring tasks telemetry to monitor weekly completion rate for recurring work in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for habits or routines that are slipping, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Todoist recurring tasks data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors weekly completion rate for recurring work so you can spot habits or routines that are slipping before it becomes annoying.
